Alternaria_Leaf_Spot.quote: The disease attacks leaves, stems, curds/heads, seed pods, and seed.
Leaf symptoms include round, brown spots with concentric rings.

Downy_Mildew.quote: Pale brown to gray discoloration will appear on the surface of the curd or head, and grayish or black spots will develop on the stem beneath.
Small, angular, light green to yellow lesions on the upper leaf surface enlarge with the development of disease and form irregularly-shaped necrotic patches.
